segments.EXO.32.5-6: Aaron builds an altar and the people hold a feast
segments.EXO.32.7-8: The LORD tells Moses that the people worship a calf
segments.EXO.32.9-11: The LORD plans to destroy the people; Moses pleads
segments.EXO.32.12-14: The LORD does not harm the people because Moses prays
segments.EXO.32.15-16: Moses comes down the mountain with the two tablets
segments.EXO.32.17-18: Joshua hears noise in the camp, and Moses hears singing
segments.EXO.32.19-20: Moses breaks the tablets and destroys the calf
segments.EXO.32.21-24: Moses questions Aaron, who blames the people
segments.EXO.32.25-27: Moses orders the Levites to kill those who sinned
segments.EXO.32.28-29: About three thousand die, and the Levites are blessed
segments.EXO.32.30-32: Moses asks the LORD to forgive the people’s sin
segments.EXO.32.33-35: The LORD will punish sin and sends a plague
segments.EXO.33.1-3: The LORD will not go with the Israelites to the land
segments.EXO.33.4-6: The Israelites mourn and take off jewelry
segments.EXO.33.7-9: The LORD speaks with Moses at the tent outside the camp
segments.EXO.33.10-11: The people worship as the LORD speaks with Moses
segments.EXO.33.12-13: Moses asks the LORD to show him the LORD’s ways
segments.EXO.33.14-16: The LORD promises to go with Moses and the people
segments.EXO.33.17-18: The LORD agrees, and Moses asks to see God’s glory
segments.EXO.33.19-20: The LORD says Moses cannot see God’s face and live
segments.EXO.33.21-23: The LORD will hide Moses in a rock as his glory passes
segments.EXO.34.1-2: The LORD tells Moses to cut two new stone tablets
segments.EXO.34.3-4: Moses goes up Mount Sinai alone with the two tablets
segments.EXO.34.5-7: The LORD passes Moses and proclaims his name
segments.EXO.34.8-9: Moses worships and asks the LORD to forgive the people
segments.EXO.34.10-11: The LORD makes a covenant and promises wonders
segments.EXO.34.12-14: Israel must not make treaties or worship other gods
segments.EXO.34.15-17: Israel must not marry into peoples who worship idols
segments.EXO.34.18-18: Israel must keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread
segments.EXO.34.19-20: The LORD says the firstborn belong to him
segments.EXO.34.21-22: Israel must rest on the seventh day and keep two feasts
segments.EXO.34.23-24: Israel’s men must go to the LORD three times a year
segments.EXO.34.25-26: The LORD gives rules about sacrifices and firstfruits
segments.EXO.34.27-28: Moses writes the covenant words on the tablets
segments.EXO.34.29-31: Moses’ face shines and the Israelites are afraid
segments.EXO.34.32-33: Moses gives the LORD’s commands, then veils his face
segments.EXO.34.34-35: Moses removes the veil when he speaks with the LORD
segments.EXO.35.10-12: Skilled workers must make the tabernacle and the ark
segments.EXO.35.13-16: Skilled workers must make the table, lampstand and altars
segments.EXO.35.17-19: Workers must make the courtyard and the priests’ clothes
segments.EXO.35.20-22: The Israelites bring gold jewelry for the LORD’s work
segments.EXO.35.23-24: The people bring cloth, skins, metal and wood
segments.EXO.35.25-26: Skilled women spin yarn and goat hair for the work
segments.EXO.35.27-29: Leaders and people give stones, spices and oil freely
segments.EXO.35.30-33: The LORD has filled Bezalel with skill for crafts
segments.EXO.35.34-35: The LORD gives Bezalel and Oholiab skill to teach others
segments.EXO.36.1-1: Bezalel, Oholiab and others will build the sanctuary
segments.EXO.36.2-4: Moses calls the skilled workers to begin the work
segments.EXO.36.5-7: The people are told to stop bringing offerings
segments.EXO.36.8-10: The craftsmen make ten linen curtains for the tabernacle
segments.EXO.36.11-13: The craftsmen join the curtains with loops and gold clasps
segments.EXO.36.14-17: The craftsmen make eleven curtains of goat hair
segments.EXO.36.20-23: The craftsmen make acacia frames for the tabernacle
segments.EXO.36.24-26: The craftsmen make silver bases for the frames
segments.EXO.36.27-28: The craftsmen make frames for the back of the tabernacle
segments.EXO.36.29-30: The craftsmen join the corner frames and set them on bases
segments.EXO.36.31-34: The craftsmen make gold-covered crossbars for the frames
segments.EXO.37.1-3: Bezalel makes the ark of acacia wood and gold
segments.EXO.37.4-5: Bezalel makes poles for carrying the ark
segments.EXO.37.6-6: Bezalel makes the mercy seat of pure gold
segments.EXO.37.7-9: Bezalel makes two gold cherubim on the mercy seat
segments.EXO.37.10-13: Bezalel makes the gold-covered table with rings
segments.EXO.37.14-16: Bezalel makes poles and gold utensils for the table
segments.EXO.37.17-19: Bezalel makes the gold lampstand with six branches
segments.EXO.37.20-22: Bezalel adds cups and buds to the lampstand
segments.EXO.37.23-24: Bezalel makes the lamps and tools from one talent of gold
segments.EXO.37.25-26: Bezalel makes the square altar of incense
segments.EXO.37.27-29: Bezalel makes poles, anointing oil and incense
segments.EXO.38.1-3: Bezalel makes the bronze altar and its utensils
segments.EXO.38.4-5: Bezalel makes a bronze grate and rings for the altar
segments.EXO.38.6-7: Bezalel makes bronze-covered poles for the altar
segments.EXO.38.9-10: The craftsmen make the south side of the courtyard
segments.EXO.38.11-12: The craftsmen make the north and west sides of the courtyard
segments.EXO.38.13-16: The craftsmen make the east side of the courtyard
segments.EXO.38.17-20: The craftsmen finish the posts, entrance curtain and pegs
segments.EXO.38.21-23: The tabernacle inventory names Bezalel and Oholiab
segments.EXO.38.24-26: The gold and silver given for the sanctuary are counted
segments.EXO.38.27-29: The silver is used for bases and hooks; bronze is counted
segments.EXO.38.30-31: The bronze is used for bases, the altar and tent pegs
segments.EXO.39.1-1: The workers made the holy clothes for Aaron
segments.EXO.39.2-3: Bezalel made the ephod of linen, gold and colored yarn
segments.EXO.39.4-5: The workers added shoulder pieces and a waistband
segments.EXO.39.6-7: The workers put engraved onyx stones on the ephod
segments.EXO.39.8-9: The workers made a square breastpiece
segments.EXO.39.10-13: Workers mounted four rows of gemstones on the breastpiece
segments.EXO.39.17-18: The workers fastened the gold chains to the shoulder pieces
segments.EXO.39.19-20: The workers made four more gold rings
segments.EXO.39.21-21: Workers tied the breastpiece to the ephod with a blue cord
segments.EXO.39.22-24: The workers made the blue robe with pomegranates on the hem
segments.EXO.39.25-26: The workers added gold bells between the pomegranates
segments.EXO.39.27-29: The workers made linen clothes for Aaron and his sons
segments.EXO.39.32-35: Israel finished the tabernacle and brought it to Moses
segments.EXO.39.36-39: Israel brought the table, lampstand and altars to Moses
segments.EXO.39.40-41: Israel brought the courtyard and priests’ clothes to Moses
segments.EXO.39.42-43: Moses saw the finished work and blessed the Israelites
segments.EXO.40.1-2: The LORD told Moses when to set up the tabernacle
segments.EXO.40.3-4: Moses must put the ark, table and lampstand in the tent
segments.EXO.40.5-7: Moses must set up the altars, the basin and the curtain
segments.EXO.40.8-11: Moses must set up the courtyard and anoint everything
segments.EXO.40.12-13: Moses must wash and clothe Aaron to serve as priest
segments.EXO.40.14-16: Moses must also clothe and anoint Aaron’s sons as priests
segments.EXO.40.17-20: Moses set up the tabernacle and the ark
segments.EXO.40.21-23: Moses placed the ark, the veil and the table
segments.EXO.40.24-25: Moses placed the lampstand and set up the lamps
segments.EXO.40.26-27: Moses placed the gold altar and burned incense on it
segments.EXO.40.28-30: Moses placed the altar and basin and made offerings
segments.EXO.40.31-33: Priests washed at the basin, and Moses finished the work
segments.EXO.40.34-35: The cloud covered the tent and the LORD’s glory filled it
segments.EXO.40.36-38: The cloud showed the Israelites when to travel
